items.quote: In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
items.claim: A calendar-based religious observance on the first day of the seventh month prescribes a trumpet-blowing ceremony and holy assembly.
items.action: have a sabbath and memorial of blowing of trumpets
items.mechanism: blowing of trumpets; calendar-based temporal prescription
